participant_1.name: Emma
participant_1.personality: Optimistic and resilient, Emma believes in the power of positivity and is always looking for ways to uplift herself and others.
participant_1.background: I am a cancer survivor. I am a clean eater. I got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. I love running and preparing for marathons.
